name: Pizzeria Vaatika Cafe
why_it_matters: A wood-fire pizza terrace overlooking the Assi Ghat aarti site — long the default backpacker meeting point on the southern ghats. Apple pie has its own following; the Italian-Indian crossover menu is consistent enough that BHU students keep returning.
insider_tip: Climb to the upper terrace 30 minutes before the 6pm aarti for an unobstructed view. Service slows during ceremony hours — order before the crowd arrives.

name: Open Hand Shop & Cafe
why_it_matters: Cafe-plus-fair-trade-shop on the Assi-Lanka stretch — proceeds support local artisans. Sandwiches, wraps, baked goods, slow Wi-Fi. Long stays welcomed; works as a midday photographer base when the ghats heat up.
insider_tip: Open 7:30am-9pm. The retail side stocks block-printed scarves and stationery — useful if you skipped Cottage Emporium. Power sockets at most tables.
signature_address: B1/128-3, Assi-Lanka Road, opposite Sparrow Cafe, Bhadaini, Varanasi 221005

name: Brown Bread Bakery
why_it_matters: Started 2006 as Varanasi's first organic bakery — bakes German recipes with local organic flour. Funds the Learn for Life vocational programme; trainees come from underserved communities, get fair wages and healthcare alongside the kitchen apprenticeship.
insider_tip: The Tulsi Ghat (Shivala Road) outpost is closer to Assi for breakfast; the Pandey Ghat flagship has the wood-fire oven and full evening menu. Bread sells out by 4pm — buy a loaf early if it's for a train.
signature_address: Pandey Ghat, near Bangali Tola, Varanasi 221001
